description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 1 (Approved drawings) for Application Reference Number: 25/02102/HOU (Erection of single storey rear extension) dated 31/10/2025. Variation to consist of changes to the rear and side elevation openings and removal of rooflight.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission ref: 25/02102/HOU dated 31.10.2025.Reason: As required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development shall be carried out and thereafter maintained in full accordance with the provisions of the Reasonable Exception Statement (Fire Safety Statement) submitted on 29 August 2025.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates and maintains the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire Safety) of the London Plan.
